# Lumen — source record

- **Origin:** the supplied experimental intake already in the Robot Lab experimental registry (CrispStrobe, BSD-3-Clause), reviewed natively before promotion.
- **Adaptations (made at intake, unchanged here):** the licence line points at the packaged licence. Geometry and program are unchanged.
- **Law (`geared-iris-v1`):** one ring gear meshes six leaf gears; every leaf turns by leaf/input = −z_in/z_leaf and the ring by ring/input, from the compiled gear ratios.
- **Disconnection** (`ring_top` removed): the 60-tooth ring that meshes all six leaves; the input still drives leaf 0 but leaves 1–5 leave the gear law (measured 181°, loss needs > 5°).
